fixtures.camera: Normal game camera and actual native GPU pipeline via Mesa llvmpipe. For controlled overlays, rendering was paused between an ordinary frame, rack-hidden, hero-hidden and both-hidden frames. Positions, load and yaw were staged for these fixtures. Walk, Run and reversal use touch events in the same game scene. Each process used a disposable profile.
fixtures.measurement: Each carried mesh vertex is transformed through its visible instance and projected by the actual orthographic camera. Per family bounds include only visible units. Whole-pack bounds also include the authored frame. Hero denominator is the foreground mask in the same view, using a minimum change of 32 sRGB levels against a complementary frame; well-separated low-saturation shadows are excluded. The source width scans use the documented 80 px median stack and 105 px median actor width in reference B48; multiple-row and extremal silhouette measurements may differ.
fixtures.coat: At each exact pose, the coat ROI runs from 34 to 79 percent of standing body pixel height. Blue samples meet B>1.32R, B>1.22G and B−R>19; orange samples use R>112, R>1.72G, G>1.62B, R−B>81. These thresholds approximate the color families. Owner chest ROI is the interior torso rectangle in Primary-sources.json. Source and gameplay have different camera, lighting and antialiasing.

B48.scope: High single-family reference load. Pixel widths isolate shaft away from the wall, not total AABB including shadows or VFX. Count and game-space scale are unknown.
